title: Extensions and torsors on the Zariski site
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let X_Zar be its small Zariski site [def-sc-zariski-site], and let G be an abelian sheaf on X_Zar [def-sc-gm-torsor, def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]. The isomorphism classes of G-torsors are canonically in bijection with equivalence classes of short exact sequences of abelian sheaves $0\to G\to E\to \mathbf Z_X\to0$, by sending a sequence to its fibre over 1 and sending a torsor T to the sheaf coproduct of its contracted powers $T^{\otimes n}$ for $n\in\mathbf Z$.
